description: Managed device driver for the Bolin PTZ Camera.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: Bolin header, stock Cognio controls; the zoom + and - buttons now match what they do.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect and Disconnect buttons: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only after the camera answers, and a camera that stops answering is dropped and retried.
